summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing that the company was named to TIME Canada's Best Companies 2026 list. The filing contains no special-situation transaction; it is a routine press release regarding a company award. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisors, no structural mechanics, and no risk-arb angle. The filing does not relate to an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is purely a corporate recognition announcement with no event-driven implications.
